candidates.topic: jazz soundtrack for a long cook
candidates.message: A slow broth wants a slow record. Do you have a jazz album you save for long evenings in the kitchen, or does the cooking get silence?
candidates.rationale: Joins their two interests, jazz records and home cooking, around the cook they planned for tonight, without going back to the ramen itself, which was the last proactive topic.

candidates.message: Some jazz records only feel right once it gets dark at four, like late-night trio albums. Which one in your collection is your winter record?
candidates.rationale: A real question about their taste in jazz records, an interest they listed that has not come up in recent proactive messages. It suits the late-November afternoon in Berlin.
